title: payment.refund.failed
description: Published by billing-service (RabbitMQ order.exchange, ADR-0034) when PaymentService.refundPayment finds a precondition unmet (Payment missing or not APPROVED) or the provider genuinely declines a refund. Consumed by orders-service, driving REFUNDING -> REFUND_FAILED (a dead end, no automatic retry). Always carries failureReason; never transactionId (the failure may occur before any Payment row is even found).
